raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'ECS Fargate cluster with two microservices behind an internal NLB'

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID for the resources
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id
    Description: Private subnet 1 for ECS tasks
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id
    Description: Private subnet 2 for ECS tasks
  ContainerImage1:
    Type: String
    Description: ECR image URI for microservice 1
    Default: nginx:latest
  ContainerImage2:
    Type: String
    Description: ECR image URI for microservice 2
    Default: nginx:latest
  ContainerPort1:
    Type: Number
    Description: Container port for microservice 1
    Default: 80
  ContainerPort2:
    Type: Number
    Description: Container port for microservice 2
    Default: 80

Resources:
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: fargate-cluster
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
      DefaultCapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Weight: 1

  CloudWatchLogsGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /ecs/fargate-cluster
      RetentionInDays: 30

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECRPull
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                Resource: '*'

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchLogsFullAccess

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort1
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort1
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort2
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort2
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8

  TaskDefinition1:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: microservice1
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: microservice1
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage1
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort1
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref CloudWatchLogsGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: microservice1

  TaskDefinition2:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: microservice2
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: microservice2
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage2
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort2
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref CloudWatchLogsGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: microservice2

  ECSService1:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition1
      DesiredCount: 2
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref SecurityGroup
      LoadBalancers:
        - ContainerName: microservice1
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort1
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup1

  ECSService2:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition2
      DesiredCount: 2
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref SecurityGroup
      LoadBalancers:
        - ContainerName: microservice2
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort2
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup2

  NLB:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: network
      Scheme: internal
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Name: internal-nlb

  TargetGroup1:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: microservice1-tg
      Port: !Ref ContainerPort1
      Protocol: TCP
      TargetType: ip
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 10
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3

  TargetGroup2:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: microservice2-tg
      Port: !Ref ContainerPort2
      Protocol: TCP
      TargetType: ip
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: TCP
      HealthCheckPort: traffic-port
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 10
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3

  Listener1:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup1
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref NLB
      Port: !Ref ContainerPort1
      Protocol: TCP

  Listener2:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup2
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref NLB
      Port: !Ref ContainerPort2
      Protocol: TCP

  NLBEndpoint:
    Description: DNS name of the internal NLB
    Value: !GetAtt NLB.DNSName
  ClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
